description: This file defines the 'node' structure and associated methods for in-memory page management within the BoltDB key/value store, including serialization, splitting, spilling, rebalancing, and navigation of B+ tree nodes.

classes.name: node
classes.description: Represents an in-memory, deserialized page node used in the B+ tree structure of BoltDB, supporting serialization, splitting, rebalancing, and navigation.

methods.name: root
methods.description: Returns the top-level node this node is attached to.

methods.name: minKeys
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of inodes this node should have.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Calculates the size of the node after serialization.

methods.name: sizeLessThan
methods.description: Checks if the node size is less than a specified value.

methods.name: pageElementSize
methods.description: Returns the size of each page element based on node type (leaf or branch).

methods.name: childAt
methods.description: Returns the child node at a specified index.

methods.name: childIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a given child node.

methods.name: numChildren
methods.description: Returns the number of child nodes.

methods.name: nextSibling
methods.description: Returns the next sibling node with the same parent.

methods.name: prevSibling
methods.description: Returns the previous sibling node with the same parent.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a key/value pair in the node.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Removes a key from the node.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Initializes the node from a page.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes the node's items onto one or more pages.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the node into multiple smaller nodes if appropriate.

methods.name: splitTwo
methods.description: Splits the node into two nodes based on page size threshold.

methods.name: splitIndex
methods.description: Finds the index at which to split the node to fit within a page size threshold.

methods.name: spill
methods.description: Writes nodes to dirty pages, splitting as needed, and manages parent node updates.

methods.name: rebalance
methods.description: Rebalances the node by merging or redistributing with sibling nodes.

methods.name: removeChild
methods.description: Removes a child node from the node's children list.

methods.name: dereference
methods.description: Copies inode key/value references to heap memory to prevent stale pointers after memory reallocation.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Adds the node's page to the freelist for reuse.
